Build an internal tool when the manual job repeats, has clear rules, and touches data you already control.

Use a no-code builder like Retool, Appsmith or Budibase when the tool is mostly forms over a database and speed matters. Write a custom app when the logic is genuinely complex or the data is sensitive. Then host it privately, with real access control.
